units.rawText: Miss Lancet and Miss Anna spent the past two days in my room, and when they finally left, they had dark rings around their eyes.

units.rawText: They took two days and two nights to write a transcription system for me that can present data fragments in DNA form. This way, I can be of use to the Oasis!
